title: Middle East live: Iran allows several Iraqi oil tankers to pass through Hormuz strait
summary: Iran has allowed a ​number of Iraqi oil tankers to pass through the Strait of Hormuz following repeated requests from Baghdad, ​Iran’s ‌state news agency reported ⁠on Saturday. Meanwhile, the United States and Iran exchanged defiant messages ahead of Monday's scheduled announcement of new US economic sanctions. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
contentText: Syria on Saturday condemned an Israeli strike southwest of Damascus that wounded one person as a “flagrant violation of sovereignty”. The attack followed a similar strike on Tuesday, which was criticised by US ambassador to Turkey and envoy for Syria Tom Barrack. Since Bashar al-Assad’s ouster in 2024, Israel has carried out hundreds of strikes in Syria and sent troops into a UN-patrolled buffer zone that for decades separated Israeli and Syrian forces on the Golan. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
